name: West Virginia

response.rule_text: Custodian must act as soon as practicable, within a maximum of five days excluding weekends and legal holidays, by furnishing records, setting a time for inspection, or denying in writing (W. Va. Code § 29B-1-3).

fees.copy_rule: Charges capped at actual cost of reproduction (§ 29B-1-3(5)).
fees.late_penalty: Attorney fees and costs to successful litigants (§ 29B-1-7).

residency.rule_text: 'Person' includes any natural person, corporation, partnership, firm or association (§ 29B-1-2); court rejected a non-resident exclusion in Hurlbert v. Matkovich; inmates seeking habeas records restricted.

appeal.body: Circuit court (county where record is kept; Kanawha County for state agencies)
appeal.rule_text: No administrative appeal; sue in circuit court, no time limit in the Act. Appeal to the Supreme Court of Appeals within four months.

format_rule: Copies on magnetic or electronic media if requested (§ 29B-1-3(3)); 'writing' includes email regardless of form (§ 29B-1-2(5)).
notes: Read chars 0-100k and 235-335k. Courts routinely treat non-response as denial. Fee search/labor/waiver/estimate not stated in text read. Universities: not named; WVU Hospitals public body, WVU Foundation not. Legislature covered per Common Cause v. Tomblin.
